events.label: founding
events.text: City founded by Ghazi-ud-Din, named Ghaziuddinnagar.

events.label: independence movement
events.text: Ghaziabad associated with Indian independence movement from 1857.
Name shortened from Ghaziuddinnagar to Ghaziabad with railway opening.

evidence.quote: with the opening of the Railways in 1864

events.label: rail junction
events.text: Ghaziabad became junction of East Indian and Sind, Punjab and Delhi railways.

evidence.quote: the completion of the Amritsar-Saharanpur-Ghaziabad line of the Sind , Punjab and Delhi Railway in 1870

events.label: industry
events.text: First modern industry appeared in Ghaziabad.

evidence.quote: it was not until 1940 that the first modern industry appeared in Ghaziabad

events.label: boundary expansion
events.text: Municipal limits extended up to the Delhi-UP border.

evidence.quote: In 1967 , the municipal limits were extended up to the Delhi-UP border

events.label: municipal upgrade
events.text: Upgraded from Municipal Board to Municipal Corporation.

evidence.quote: It upgraded from a Municipal Board to a Municipal Corporation on 31 August 1994

events.label: election
events.text: Last local elections for all wards held.

evidence.quote: The local elections to all wards was last held in 2017

events.text: Corporation announced creation of 10 garbage factories as waste solution.

evidence.quote: The corporation also announced in September 2020 that it was creating 10 garbage factories

undated_mentions: Scientific Society established here during the educational movement of Syed Ahmad Khan (year not stated)
Scinde, Punjab & Delhi Railway opened through Ghaziabad in the same period (year not stated)
22 factories opened in the four years after 1947
Steel-manufacturing units came up in the early 1970s
Electronics industry emerged in the early 1970s with setting up of BEL and CEL
Development as a centre of the Oil Engines industry in the period after 1947
Pratap Vihar landfill use stopped on orders of a National Green Tribunal committee (date not stated)
